Wouldn’t recommend
Mar 2026 • Friends
Food was okay, but the service really ruined the experience.

I got my pizza first, but my friend had to wait another 10–15 minutes for his burger. I had already finished eating by then. The staff felt stressed, shouting orders across the restaurant and just dropping the food on the table.

We also didn’t get our water or drinks until AFTER my food arrived, and only after we had to ask.

When we asked about the burger, they said they would check but never came back to update us. About 15 minutes after mine arrived, it finally showed up. The waiter actually walked past our table first, put the food down somewhere else, and only brought it over when we said something. No apology, just excuses. Even hinting that it was another staff members fault. 

The drinks were also weird. One tasted like it had no alcohol, while another was way too strong.

Overall, not a great experience. I wouldn’t come back.

Beautiful view but poor food & service
May 2025 • Friends
Location and decor looks very great. But beyond that, you just end up paying a lot of money for not so good tasting food and very poor service. I ordered the beef burger and I can safely say that it does not taste like a real burger : meat does not look cooked on the grill, bread buns were not even toasted, poor dressing. We were going as a group and it took an eternity for us to get our food and our drinks. We were not served at the same time so I was finished eating when the last person at our table got their meal. I would advise the staff to put more love and care in their food, make more research because it looks like an attempt more than anything. I would not recommend this place for a meal, too expensive for what you get ; street food has been much tastier than this.
